mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guild_chats ( guild_id, sender_user_id, message_type, content ) VALUES ( #{guildId}, #{senderUserId}, COALESCE(#{messageType}, 'USER'), #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT t.chat_id, t.guild_id, t.user_id, t.nickname, t.profile_image_url, t.character_id, t.character_name, t.character_level, t.message_type, t.message, t.created_at, t.is_me FROM ( SELECT gc.chat_id, gc.guild_id, gc.sender_user_id AS user_id, CASE WHEN gc.message_type = 'SYSTEM' THEN 'SYSTEM' ELSE u.nickname END AS nickname, u.profile_image_url, c.character_id, c.name AS character_name, c.level AS character_level, gc.message_type, gc.content AS message, gc.created_at, CASE WHEN gc.sender_user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_me FROM guild_chats gc LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gc.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE gc.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gc.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY gc.created_at DESC, gc.chat_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) t ORDER BY t.created_at ASC, t.chat_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM guild_chats WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT gc.chat_id, gc.guild_id, gc.sender_user_id AS user_id, CASE WHEN gc.message_type = 'SYSTEM' THEN 'SYSTEM' ELSE u.nickname END AS nickname, u.profile_image_url, c.character_id, c.name AS character_name, c.level AS character_level, gc.message_type, gc.content AS message, gc.created_at, CASE WHEN gc.sender_user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_me FROM guild_chats gc LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gc.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE gc.chat_id = #{chatId} AND gc.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
